text:
anya: Quick bench dump — trying to get a clean cost-per-token curve A100 vs H100 for 7B open models across regions. posting top-level findings then a short appendix command for repro.

sam: nice, TL;DR first pls — we need numbers for capacity planning.

anya: TL;DR top-line (mistral-7b, q8x4 vs q4_0, US-west):
- A100 (q8x4): prefill ~22ms, decode ~14ms, tokens/sec ~680, $/1M tokens ≈ $32
- A100 (q4_0): prefill ~28ms, decode ~18ms, tokens/sec ~520, $/1M tokens ≈ $24
- H100 (q8x4): prefill ~14ms, decode ~8ms, tokens/sec ~1200, $/1M tokens ≈ $20
- H100 (q4_0): prefill ~18ms, decode ~10ms, tokens/sec ~980, $/1M tokens ≈ $16

jess: those $/1M look lower for H100 than I expected — did you include amortized infra and network egress?

anya: yes, costing includes instance/hour, average GPU util, and cross-AZ egress when applicable. this is tokenized user-visible output; we used 1M tokens = request+response tokens.

rafa: what about EU and APAC deltas? tail latencies?

anya: EU (eu-central) adds ~+6–10% tail on A100 due to batch packing differences. H100 shows smaller region delta (~+3–5%). APAC was worse on A100 when we hit thermal throttling on our test SKU (q8x4, prolonged runs) — we saw a 12% drop in sustained tokens/sec after 2h. H100 sustained throughput stable in the same run.

sam: interesting. kernel choices? did you force cuBLAS kernels or let runtime pick fast attention kernels?

anya: runtime left kernel selection automatic. noteworthy notes: q8x4 + fast-attn kernel gives best decode throughput on H100; on A100 we saw frequent kernel fallbacks to slower matmul path for sequence >1024, hurting prefill. we captured logs.

bench-bot: paste of command used for runs:
```
./run_infer_bench --model mistral-7b --quant q8x4 --gpu a100 --seq 2048 --batch 1 --duration 600 --collect tokens_per_sec,latency,prefill_ms,decode_ms,cost_estimate
```

bench-bot: and for H100 just --gpu h100, same flags.

jess: did you test llama2-7b and mosaic-7b as well? any regressions with q5_0 style quant?

anya: llama2-7b behaved similarly to mistral for q8x4 vs q4_0 split but mosaic-7b had a bigger perf gap on A100 (~30% lower tokens/sec vs H100). q5_0 gave slightly better cost for some workloads but quality regression on a few eval prompts — we logged eval diffs and will attach.

rafa: do we have a quick plot for $/1M tokens vs tokens/sec so product can see tradeoffs?

anya: I generated a small CSV and a 1-page plot. will upload to the bench drive, link in a follow-up. early take: H100 dominates on latency and tokens/sec at similar or lower $/1M for most 7B quant configs, but A100 can win if you can accept higher prefill and you aggressively use q5/q4 with high cache hit rates.

sam: action items: 1) add H100 SKU to Dedicated sizing guidance for EU and US, 2) add thermal/run-duration test to gating for APAC SKUs, 3) surface kernel-fallback alerts in Console when seq>1024 and perf drops.

anya: yep. I'll open a GH issue with repro scripts and CSVs, tag @rafa and @jess for follow-up.

infra-bot: deployment note — we saw a small flakiness on A100 nodes during long sustained runs (driver 525.89), recommend driver bump and node-reboot test before large commits.

anya: thanks — will include driver note. quick note: these threads are short but I can paste raw logs if anyone wants deeper numbers. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
